subject: POC stewardship & deployment responsibilities — steward handshake and next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@alphaapps.com>, Tom Hernandez <tom.h@alphaapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC stewardship & deployment responsibilities — steward handshake and next steps

Hi Elaine / Tom — great call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed handoff so we’re aligned on who owns what during the 6-week POC: clear success criteria, a minimal evaluation plan, and immediate next actions. Please confirm or correct any item below.

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood Inference in Alpha Apps’ staging environment to measure latency at 95th pct, cost per 1k tokens, and end-to-end functional correctness for the customer chat flow.

Success criteria (alpha team accepts POC):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 500ms for 512-token responses under baseline load (30 qps).
- Cost: projected per-1k-token cost within 25% of our estimate in the attached spreadsheet.
- Functional: >= 98% pass rate on the provided prompt-suite (see alpha_poc_success_criteria.xlsx).
- Security/Compliance: network path validated, no external egress to unapproved endpoints; encryption at rest confirmed.

Evaluation plan (minimal):
- Week 0 (this week): Network diagram, whitelist IPs, share service account. (Owners: Alpha infra / Redwood SE)
- Week 1–2: Deploy model variant (gpt-variant-3q) to staging, run synthetic load tests, collect latency/cost metrics. (Owners: Redwood SE, Alpha app infra)
- Week 3–4: Run customer prompt-suite against staging, review failures, tune prompts and batching configs. (Owners: Alpha app, Redwood SE)
- Week 5–6: Final validation window; decision meeting on go/no-go and procurement. (Owners: Alpha product, Alpha procurement, Redwood CS)

Proposed steward/RACI (who to loop for each lane):
- App owner (integration, test cases): Tom Hernandez (Alpha Apps) — R
- Infra owner (network, VPC, whitelists): Elaine Park (Alpha Apps) — R
- Security reviewer (policy, access control): Elaine Park (cc procurement contact as necessary) — A
- Redwood SE (deployment, metric collection): Ben Carter (redwood) — R
- Redwood CS / Success (engagement, timelines): Marissa Cole (redwood) — C
- Onboarding/project lead (scheduling, e2e acceptance): Karthik Iyer (redwood) — A

Immediate asks for this week (by EOD Wednesday):
1) Elaine/Tom: confirm the infra contact who will provide the staging VPC, and attach the current network diagram (or allow us to review).
2) Alpha procurement: send any standard SOW or quick-PO templates if you want procurement parallelized with the POC.
3) Ben: I’ve attached a first-pass checklist and network diagram request (alpha_network_diagram_v1.pdf). Please confirm the ports/IPs needed.

Attachments: alpha_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (success metrics + prompts), alpha_network_diagram_v1.pdf (requested), redwood_onboarding_checklist.docx

Thanks — I’ll pull together a shared calendar invite for the kickoff once we confirm infra points of contact.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC stewardship & deployment responsibilities — steward handshake and next steps

Thanks Logan — this looks good and captures the call. Quick clarifications from Alpha Apps: 

1) Infra contact: I will be the primary infra owner for the POC (provisioning, whitelists). I’ll loop in our network engineer (Javier Morales) to share the VPC details; Javier will communicate directly with Ben.
2) Timeline tweak: we prefer to start the deployment in Week 1 (not Week 0) because we need 4 business days to spin a staging cluster and apply security baseline configs. That pushes the synthetic load tests to Week 2–3 and the prompt-suite to Week 4. The overall window still ends in Week 6.
3) Security: we need Redwood to complete a short (2-page) access matrix that lists what tokens/keys Redwood needs and where data is stored during the POC. Can Ben draft that this week?
4) Procurement: I copied procurement@alphaapps.com so they can indicate whether a PO or a temporary MSA amendment is required for this pilot.

I’ve attached a current network diagram to this reply (see alpha_network_diagram_v1.pdf). We will redact internal IPs before sending publicly if needed.

Elaine Park
Director, Platform Operations — Alpha Apps
elaine.park@alphaapps.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@alphaapps.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC stewardship & deployment responsibilities — steward handshake and next steps

Appreciate the prompt reply, Elaine — confirmed on the timeline shift (Week 1 deployment). Action items from SE side:

- I will produce the Access Matrix (requested) by EOD Wednesday. It will include: service account scopes, token rotation cadence, temporary keys used during POC, and data residency notes.
- Network requirements: Redwood needs outbound-only access to our telemetry endpoints (listed in the onboarding checklist) and port 443 open to the inference cluster IP(s). If Alpha is using private egress, we can support a VPC peering flow; otherwise IP whitelisting will work.
- Test plan details (short):
  * Day 1 (deploy): deploy model container into Alpha staging; smoke test basic responses. (Owner: Ben)
  * Day 2–3 (integration): app integration and sample prompts; capture functional failures. (Owner: Tom / Alpha app)
  * Day 4–10 (load): Redwood runs synthetic load with 3 profiles (baseline, burst, sustained). We’ll collect 95p latency, p50/p95 token throughput, and cost samples. (Owner: Ben with logs shared to Alpha)
  * Day 11–14 (analysis): joint triage; tune batching and quantization settings. (Owners: Ben + Tom)

RACI (technical detail, please confirm):
- Staging infra provisioning: Alpha (R) / Redwood (C)
- Network approval and access controls: Alpha (A) / Redwood (C)
- Model deployment & runtime tuning: Redwood SE (R) / Alpha app (C)
- Metric collection and shared dashboards: Redwood (R) / Alpha product (C)

Attachments: I’ve updated the onboarding checklist with the access matrix template (redwood_onboarding_checklist.docx).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — final confirmation and next steps from project lead side:

   - Kickoff meeting (calendar invite): Thu 2027-04-15 10:00 AM PT
   - Model deployed to staging: target Tue 2027-04-20
   - Synthetic load complete: Fri 2027-04-30
   - Prompt-suite validation window: Mon 2027-05-03 — Fri 2027-05-14
   - Decision meeting: Mon 2027-05-17

2) Owners confirmed: Tom (App), Elaine (Infra/Sec), Ben (Redwood SE), Marissa (CS), Karthik (Onboarding/Project Lead).

3) Deliverables before kickoff:
   - Alpha: share staging VPC contact + any required NDA redactions on the network diagram (Elaine).
   - Alpha procurement: indicate whether a PO or a short SOW is needed (procurement@alphaapps.com).
   - Redwood: Ben to share access matrix and a short SRE runbook for the POC (contains rollback steps, logs path).

If there are any objections to the milestone dates above, flag them now — otherwise I’ll treat them as committed.

Thanks — Karthik
